product.title: Black Widow 3.0 Dynasty
product.body_html:
NOT A REPEAT—A REVOLUTION IN WIDOW POWER!

The Black Widow 3.0 Dynasty was created to enhance the line by not re-creating what is already on the market but offering something new. The Black Widow 3.0 Dynasty's HK22 Cohesion Solid cover provides more overall hook than a Black Widow 2.0 and more length and flip compared to a Black Widow 3.0. This is the strongest Black Widow to date, while complementing the big hooking oil balls like Maximum Effect, and Zero Mercy Solid as a ball to step down to.

BALL SPECS

  • PERFORMANCE Upper Mid
  • PART NUMBER 60-108557-93X
  • COLOR Ultraviolet / Black
  • COREGas Mask
  • COVERSTOCK HK22 - Cohesion Solid
  • COVER TYPESolid Reactive
  • FINISH 500, 1000, 2000 Siaair Micro Pad
  • WEIGHTS 16-12 Pounds
  • LANE CONDITION Medium to heavy oil
  • REACTION Aggressive mid-lane and backend
  • WARRANTY Two years from purchase date
  • RELEASE DATE January 15, 2026
